narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#4265

## What to build

`.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml` post-publish two-pass fixture (#4271) must retry / backoff until the four `@deftai/directive*` packages are queryable, or warn without failing the job, after the four `npm publish` steps have already succeeded.

v0.115.0 and v0.116.0 both printed `+ @deftai/directive-types@…`, `+ @deftai/directive-core@…`, `+ @deftai/directive-content@…`, `+ @deftai/directive@…`, then the fixture `node ./packages/core/dist/release-e2e/npm-ops.js --post-publish-two-pass` failed immediately with `ETARGET` / `No matching version found`. Core is the large tarball (~2.4 MB); npm itself prints `Your package is being processed and may take a few minutes to become available.` The GitHub Actions run is then red on the tag.

This is not #4267. #4267 is Phase 7 operator wait for registry truth. This issue is the CI job going red after a successful publish, which stalls Phase 5 (`gh run watch` exit 1, then manual registry polling before flipping the GitHub draft).

Do not unpublish. Do not skip provenance. Do not treat a red fixture as proof the packages did not ship.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After all four publish steps succeed, the two-pass fixture retries `npm view` (bounded, with backoff) until each cut version is listed, or records warn-only when publish already printed `+ pkg@version`.
- [ ] A successful four-package publish with a still-propagating registry does not fail `npm-publish.yml`.
- [ ] Publish-step failure still fails the job.
- [ ] Tests lock retry/warn vs real publish failure without hitting the live registry.
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.
- [ ] `task check` passes.

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None -- can start immediately.

## Refs

#4271, #4267, #3753, #1910. v0.115.0 and v0.116.0 cuts.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-11T16:14:41Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Open critique of #4398 at pin a26c7ba01145c147a1999ddc657051e7a64c659a. Ceiling 5637262406 inclusive. Charter open critique, spend N=1, round 1.

## Inventory (re-verified at the pin)

`.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml` is one job `publish`. Four `npm publish --provenance` steps, then step "Post-publish two-pass fixture (#4271)" runs `node ./packages/core/dist/release-e2e/npm-ops.js --post-publish-two-pass "${VERSION}"`. No `continue-on-error`. No second `needs: publish` job.

`packages/core/src/release-e2e/npm-ops.ts` CLI: one call to `invokePostPublishTwoPassFromReleaseWorkflow`; `!ok` then `process.exit(1)`. `runPostPublishTwoPassFixture` runs a single `npm install` of the four `name@version` specs (`runNpmStep`, no retry, no `--ignore-scripts`), then `assertTagBoundDirectiveVersions` (manifest version equals tag), then Pass 2. `NPM_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 600` is a spawn timeout, not a retry loop. An immediate ETARGET does not wait out that timeout.

REST jobs:

- v0.116.0 run 34599049672: four publish steps success; fixture failure 12:28:54-12:28:55 (1s). Check-run annotations: "Process completed with exit code 1." Job logs 404 from this session.
- v0.115.0 run 34540681970: same shape; fixture 23:08:14-23:08:15 (1s). v0.114.0 run 34426739978 success (pre-fixture cuts).

`pollWorkspacePackages` in `packages/core/src/release/cli-drift-report.ts`: 10-minute constant, 30s interval, default `sleepMs` no-op, skipped when `CI` / `GITHUB_ACTIONS`, report-only. #4267 recut (successor lean 5636989398, synthesis 5636998607) owns a production Phase 7 caller of that poller; keep the two-pass fixture off that list. Do not fold.

#4271 (closed) added this fixture as closure: separate `needs: publish` job, `--ignore-scripts` registry install, tag-bind (provenance or tag-built digest), "`npm view` version/integrity is not the pass", hard-fail after a bounded wait. Pin shipped the fixture as a final step inside `publish` without ignore-scripts and without a retry loop.

## Injection / swarm lens

This lean changes the authority of `npm-publish.yml` conclusion (Phase 5 `gh run watch`), shared registry state, and four-way non-atomic publish. `npm install` / `npm view` bytes are untrusted network output. Fresh registry tarballs running lifecycle scripts is untrusted input. Do not unpublish. Do not skip `--provenance` on the publish steps. Do not treat a red fixture as proof the four publishes did not ship. The converse also holds: a green workflow after warn-only is not proof the two-pass ran.

## Finding 1 — blocks-the-design

Evidence: AC bullet 1 says the fixture retries `npm view` until each cut version is listed. Pin failing call is one-shot `npm install @deftai/directive-types@V @deftai/directive-core@V @deftai/directive-content@V @deftai/directive@V` then exit 1. #4271: npm view is not the pass. Measured: fixture step died in 1s after four successful publish steps on v0.115.0 and v0.116.0.

Failure mode: a builder can add a bounded `npm view` loop, keep the existing one-shot install, lock tests on view, and the 1-second red step remains (view-list membership can precede tarball fetch; ETARGET is an install resolver miss).

Disposition: do not bind until retry or warn wraps the failing call (the tag-bound registry install / the fixture invoke), then keep `assertTagBoundDirectiveVersions`. Do not substitute view-list membership for that install.

## Finding 2 — sharpens-framing

Evidence: AC states retry-until-listed or warn-only when publish printed `+ pkg@version`. Those are opposite job-exit policies. Retry-after-bound still fails `npm-publish.yml` (AC bullet 2 forbids that for a still-propagating registry). Warn-only keeps the workflow green and defers #4271 two-pass closure for that cut. `NPM_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 600` does not implement retry.

Failure mode: an implementer picks view-retry with a short bound, or warn-only that silently drops the closure job, and both read as AC-complete. Phase 5 then either still stalls or treats green as two-pass proof.

Disposition: pick one job-exit policy. If retry: name the bound against measured lag (1s fail; npm "few minutes"; core 404 for several minutes on 0.116.0 per #4267 comment 5636659399) and real backoff (do not copy `pollWorkspacePackages`'s no-op default sleep). If warn-only: say two-pass closure is deferred, not deleted; publish-step failure still fails the job (AC already).

## Finding 3 — footnote

`pollWorkspacePackages` is the existing wait mechanism. It is skipped in CI, report-only, and owned by the #4267 recut. Using it as this fixture's fail-closed control folds those issues. Pin topology (fixture as last step of `publish`) is why four green publish steps still paint the job red; `continue-on-error` on that step is a warn-only vehicle, not Phase 7. Pin install omits `--ignore-scripts`; keep that #4271 flag on any retried registry install.

## Road not taken

Fold the drift poller into the fixture: rejected. #4267 recut is report-only and skipped in CI; this issue is fail-closed CI after successful `npm publish`.

Split a `needs: publish` job and leave it fail-closed: still fails `npm-publish.yml` as a workflow, so it does not meet AC bullet 2 unless the fixture job is also warn-only.

Steelman of warn-only: Phase 5 stall is the operator pain; #4271 durable closure can be a later named check. What would flip that: two-pass must remain a named check on the tag run, so green cannot mean "publish steps succeeded, fixture skipped."

Steelman of view-retry: cheaper proxy for queryability. What would flip that: the measured 1s install fail and #4271's "npm view is not the pass."

## In plain English

Four npm publish steps succeed, then the two-pass fixture one-shots npm install of the four specs and exits 1 in about a second while core is still propagating. Phase 5 sees a red run after the packages already shipped.

If this map is confirmed, the next-build retries the failing registry install (not npm view as the pass), with real backoff against measured lag. After the bound, warn-only so the job stays green. Publish-step failure still fails. Keep tag-bind. Keep --ignore-scripts. Do not fold #4267.

This is not an instruction to a later builder.

- Job-exit after four successful publish steps: do not fail npm-publish.yml for still-propagating registry. Retry the install with real backoff against measured lag (1s fail; npm few minutes; core 404 for several minutes on 0.116.0). After the bound, warn-only (two-pass closure deferred for that cut, not deleted). Publish-step failure still fails the job. Do not copy pollWorkspacePackages no-op default sleep.
- Keep pollWorkspacePackages / Phase 7 off this list (#4267 recut). Keep --ignore-scripts on any retried registry install. Do not unpublish. Do not skip --provenance on publish steps. CHANGELOG.
